body: ADVISORY ACCEPT exact 7ee4872c697fd1d92ffa345f0d2b188086958a72. Verified two-path diff and clean diff-tree. TransitionFeatures.between reads only measuredPosition; Backward and LongJump are constructed only for (Some, Some), so either missing endpoint omits both keys in both orders. The sole production consumer, TransitionFeatures.score, enumerates all TransitionKind values with getOrElse(0.0), so sparse absence is fail-closed numerically while remaining distinguishable in the public diagnostics map. The foil exposes an unresolved ref through the public SourceView trait and tests both placed-to-phantom and phantom-to-placed; reverting to relativePosition makes the omitted-key assertions fail. The measured same-node court retains Some(0.0) for both keys, distinguishing measured zero-valued evidence from absent keys. Non-position features remain present. Parent is 5180fea; later main deltas are AGENTS-only. I found no semantic or test objection. This is an advisory backup review; cursor-grok remains the formal candidate reviewer.
